versions.content: If a TcpIpAddrAssignment configured with TCPIP_STORE is started, TcpIp shall check the NvMBlock ( see ECUC_TcpIp_00184 : ) for a valid IP address. If a valid address is present, TcpIp shall assign this address as if it was a static address. If no valid address is present, TcpIp shall start the respective IP address assignment method related to the TcpIpAddrAssignment. Once the procedure is complete, TcpIp shall store the new address in the NvMBlock.
